Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual fits exactly four more items of the same size, continuing the band sweep. This aims to keep residuals reusable for identical items, but the band may be rarer than the two-item version and the base Best Fit term may dominate.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= 4 * item and r - item < 5 * item else 0) for r in bins]
```
